role: Single helper computing an MKCoordinateRegion bounding route coordinates with padding/minimum span.

units.does: Returns a region centred on the lat/lon midpoint with span (max-min)*paddingFactor floored at minimumDelta; empty input returns a 0,0-centred region with emptyFallbackDelta span.

branches.effect: build bounding region; else fallback (unreachable once non-empty)

flags.text: Uses raw min/max longitude; a route crossing the ±180° antimeridian gets a centre near 0° and a longitude span up to ~360*1.3, an invalid/wrong region.
After the isEmpty guard, min()/max() on non-empty arrays can't be nil, so the second fallback never runs.

Doc calls this "the one shared implementation for the app's route maps", yet three other units recompute the same min/max bounding region with their own padding: TrailRow.mapRegion, RecapCard.snapshotOptions, WorkoutPDFRenderer.mapSnapshotOptions.
